question: How can recitation of the mantra with the gaze ward off all poisons?
premises: Recitation of the mantra is prescribed.
The gaze is specified as the means.
The result stated is the warding off of all poisons.
inference: Reciting the mantra with the gaze should result in the warding off of all poisons.
plain_english: One should recite the mantra with the gaze; this should ward off all poisons.
